programme.title: Lewis & Clark
programme.desc: This four-part documentary series by Ken Burns tells the story of the momentous journey that began in 1804 when Meriwether Lewis and William Clark headed up the Missouri River to explore America's unknown spaces. The series reflects their bond of friendship as well as their vision of the West as it was before the rest of the nation followed them and changed it forever. Extensive use is made of archive material and the stunning cinematography portrays the beauty of the land itself. Part 1 of 4.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: December 1941 to March 1942. The Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor in December 1941 thrusts the United States into the global cataclysm that will eventually touch every family on every street in every town in America. Within a few months, millions of young men have entered the armed forces and are beginning to train for war. A series by Ken Burns. Part 1 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: March 1942 to December 1942. With U-boats menacing the East Coast, and little good news from overseas, many worry that the United States is utterly unprepared to fight in a 'total war'. But after six months of gruelling combat on Guadalcanal, the Americans finally stop Japan's expansion in the Pacific. A series by Ken Burns. Part 2 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: January 1943 to June 1943. American troops land in North Africa and test themselves for the first time against the German and Italian armies, learning to set aside the notion that killing is a sin, and adopting the outlook that 'killing is a craft'. Back home, cities become booming 'war towns' overnight as nearly all manufacturing is converted to the war effort, and thousands of women become industrial workers. A series by Ken Burns. Part 3 of 14.

programme.desc: July 1943 to December 1943. On daylight bombing missions, American airmen gamble with their lives against overwhelming odds to bring the war to the heart of Hitler's vast empire. Allied forces invade Sicily and then Italy but, as they grind their way towards Rome, the weather turns bad and the terrain grows more and more forbidding. Twisting mountain roads and blown bridges have to be negotiated while under constant German fire. A series by Ken Burns. Part 4 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: November 1943 to February 1944. In November, the US marines take the tiny Pacific atoll of Tarawa, but at a terrible cost. Back home, Japanese-Americans are permitted to form a special segregated infantry unit and begin to train for combat. As the war economy booms, ugly racial violence erupts in cities across the country. Overseas, in the mountains south of Rome, the allies try to fight their way around the edges of Monte Cassino, but are stopped cold. A series by Ken Burns. Part 5 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: January 1944 to June 1944. American and British troops are pinned down at Anzio for months, while at Monte Cassino, the killing goes on and on. African-Americans, incensed at the segregation of the armed forces, put pressure on the military to make some changes. In May, allied soldiers at Cassino and Anzio resume their drive northward in Italy, liberating Rome on 4 June, but they let the retreating German army get away. A series by Ken Burns. Part 6 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: 6 June 1944: D-Day. In the early hours of 6 June 1944, the invasion of France begins. A million-and-a-half men take part. It is the bloodiest day in American history since the Civil War, though the Allies succeed in tearing a 45-mile gap in Hitler's vaunted Atlantic Wall. By day's end more than 150,000 men have landed on French soil, and more men, equipment and supplies are coming ashore every hour. A series by Ken Burns. Part 7 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: June 1944 to August 1944. American and British troops in Normandy are bogged down in the hedgerows, while in the Pacific, the marines fight their costliest battle to date on the island of Saipan. Back home, dreaded telegrams from the War Department begin arriving at a rate inconceivable just one year earlier. But by mid-August, the Germans are in full retreat out of France, and on 25 August, after four years of Nazi occupation, Paris is liberated. A series by Ken Burns. Part 8 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Autumn 1944. In September of 1944, with their troops in Europe stalled on the German border having outrun their supply lines, Allied commanders gamble on a risky plan to drop thousands of airborne troops behind enemy lines in Holland. When the mission ends in disaster, it becomes painfully clear that the war in Europe will not end before winter. In the Pacific, on the island of Peleliu, the marines fight one of the most brutal campaigns of the war. A series by Ken Burns. Part 9 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Autumn 1944. In the late autumn of 1944 American soldiers suffer terrible losses when they are ordered into the forbidding and fiercely defended terrain of the H�rtgen Forest and the Vosges Mountains. In the Central Pacific, to the delight of audiences back home, General MacArthur returns to the island of Leyte. But months of bloody fighting lie ahead before the Philippine Islands, and the people imprisoned on them, can be liberated. A series by Ken Burns. Part 10 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Winter 1944 to 1945. The Allies are unprepared for Hitler's counterattack in the Ardennes Forest of Belgium and Luxembourg. It is the biggest battle of the war on the Western Front, fought during the coldest winter in memory. By the time the Battle of the Bulge is over, Hitler's enormous gamble has ended in disaster and the Russians are approaching Berlin. Meanwhile, in the Santo Tomas Camp in the Philippines, thousands of internees await liberation. A series by Ken Burns. Part 11 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Winter to Spring 1945. On the island of Iwo Jima, the marines face 21,000 Japanese defenders who, without hope of reinforcement, have been ordered to kill as many Americans as possible before being killed themselves. Once the island is taken, Allied bombers set the cities of Japan ablaze, killing thousands and leaving millions homeless. In Europe, Americans are crossing the Rhine and driving into Germany, while the Russians are within 50 miles of Berlin. A series by Ken Burns. Part 12 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Spring 1945. In the Pacific, Americans fight on the island of Okinawa while kamikaze pilots wreak havoc on the fleet offshore. In Europe, allied forces rapidly push across Germany from the east and west, and American and British troops discover the true horrors of the Nazis' industrialised barbarism at Buchenwald, Dachau, Mauthausen and other concentration camps. Finally, on 8 May, with their country in ruins and their Fuhrer dead, the Germans surrender. A series by Ken Burns. Part 13 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: May to December 1945. In June, the battle on Okinawa ends yet Japan's rulers, despite the agony their people are enduring, resist unconditional surrender. On 6 August 1945, an American plane drops an atomic bomb on Hiroshima. Two days later, Russia declares war against Japan. A second atomic bomb is dropped on Nagasaki and, finally, Japan surrenders. In the following months, hundreds of thousands of American servicemen and women return home. A series by Ken Burns. Part 14 of 14.

programme.desc: When the police in Farmington, New Mexico discover a broken window at a local head shop called The Eclectic, they expect to find evidence of a robbery. Instead they uncover a horrific crime scene, with two badly mutilated bodies. One year later, a battered body is found tossed into a canyon, the eyes and genitals gouged.Then the bloodied corpse of a naked woman is discovered on a remote road outside of town. As police search for clues to her death, tracking a lost cell phone, scattered footprints and layers of tire marks far into the desert, they soon come to a terrible realization - that one man and his friends are suspected in all three crimes. And when a renowned blood spatter expert finally determines who the murderer is, the community is shocked to learn that a serial killer has been living in their midst.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A teen girl so obsessed with her on-again, off-again boyfriend that he claims she has become a stalker, forcing him to get a restraining order… for three years! Cristie says her 19-year-old daughter Corryn started dating 17-year-old Jack almost two years ago and every time they break up, Corryn becomes a “crazy ex-girlfriend.” Jack claims Corryn calls him hundreds of times a day, breaks into his house and hides behind the bushes to watch his every move, each time violating the restraining order. But Corryn says Jack plays games with her and lures her to him every time. Cristie and Jack’s mom, Brytt, say they’ve had it and want their teens’ relationship to end today -- but what does Corryn have to say about that? Can she stop obsessing over Jack, and will she keep a promise she made to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents, Kelly and David, say they believe their daughter was murdered, and have since been working relentlessly to reopen the investigation into her death, which is now under review. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Were there clues missed in the original investigation? Then, Joe says he believed Sheena was suicidal in the days leading up to her death -- so why did he leave her alone in the hotel room after a heated argument? Does his story add up? Joe takes a polygraph to prove his innocence. Don't miss the shocking results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany says her relationship with her son’s father, Erik, was destroyed by his constant lying and empty promises, to the point where she completely cut him off and has not seen him in over three years. Erik admits he has lied to his ex-girlfriends. Then, just this past year, Erik dated Sheka who says after doing research midway through their relationship, she uncovered his lies and put a stop to their wedding plans. So, when did Erik begin to con and deceive people? As Erik is accused of one lie more shocking than the next, his mom, Jody, says her son has been lying since he was a child. And, don't miss part 2, when more women come forward from Erik’s past.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany and Sheka are not the only ones who accuse their ex-boyfriend, Erik, of constant lying and scamming throughout their relationships. Today, Dr. Phil hears from ex-girlfriends Torri and Courtney, and even Erik’s ex-wife, Martha, who all have different stories to share about Erik’s deceitful behavior. Now that Erik has been revealed as an alleged con man, will he decide to change his ways? Find out at the end of this dramatic part 2.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A couple want to evict their violent 31-year-old son, while their son blames his parents for his financial struggles.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents get help to deal with a mooching son.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Follow a dad, John Clark's journey as he searches for his missing family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: An update with a father whose children were abducted by their mother.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jeremy owns his own funeral escort company but says he’s being falsely accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison. Jeremy says videos from his funeral processions have been leaked online, received millions of views, and as a result, he is being victimized in his community and misrepresented in the media – and now, he and his attorney want to set the record straight. Dr. Phil meets Jeremy and takes a closer look into components of his business, including his motorcycle, uniform and badge. Is Jeremy “playing cop” or just doing his job? And, what’s on Jeremy’s duty belt? You won’t want to miss part one of this two-part show.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Jeremy, a funeral escort, who is being accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison. Jeremy says videos from his funeral processions have been edited and leaked online, and as a result, he is being defamed and bullied in the media. But, Jeremy says the world has it all wrong and wants to clear his name. Today, Dr. Phil meets a funeral director who has worked with Jeremy for seven years, as well as someone who’s been following his story from afar. What do they have to say? Plus, to help prove his intention is not to impersonate a police officer, Jeremy requested a polygraph test. What does the test reveal? Tune in to find out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Think you’re ready to say, “I do?”… not so fast! Dr. Phil puts 3 newly engaged couples to the test in his Premarital Boot Camp series, with real-life challenges like parenting, fighting, money, and sex. Find out what happens when one couple leaves their “baby” unattended six times and why another couple has to do some major explaining to the California Highway Patrol. Will they all make it to the altar… and who will win big prizes?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You've got the ring on your finger, but are you really ready to walk down that aisle? Dr. Phil continues his three-part series, putting relationships to the test as three engaged couples compete against each other in real-life challenges about teamwork, money, children, in-laws, personal space and sex.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's one last test for three engaged couples before they start their lives as husband and wife - or not. See how they do in Dr. Phil's hilarious "Pre-Newlywed Game!"

And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: In a moving episode, Scott welcomes 12 rescue dogs saved from the South Korean dog meat trade and gives them the medical care they need to find new homes. And a frisky feline is giving its owner some unwanted attention.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Pluto the singing Dalmatian has lost his voice and Chris fears that the cause may be sinister. Pluto is very special to Chris because he was one of Chris’ first every patients.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has returned to Hamilton in country Victoria at the invitation of Hamilton Animal Health Clinic. As the city vet it’s hardly surprising that they give him the more unusual cases to deal with including Pepper, a pig that delivers still born piglets, twin foals where one is being rejected by its mother and a visit to a farm to test the fertility of their massive stud bulls by measuring the size of their jewels.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott heads to Cornwall to take part in the seal rescue effort as heavy storms leave pups stranded along the coast. While in the area he's called upon to help out a rook with a broken wing and must perform a risky amputation.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott enlists the help of specialist surgeon Michael Hamilton to help a Pugalier with painful deformed legs; emergency surgery to remove a dangerous piece of wire from a young dog's intestines and Phoebe’s pet rabbits pay a visit to the practice.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris needs to use all his detective skills to find out why the end of Zaza, a pygmy bearded dragon’s tail keeps mysteriously falling off.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Back at the Bondi Clinic small West Highland Terrier Mr Pettibone arrives on the back of owner Henry’s Harley Davidson Motorcycle. The bikie dog has a persistent ear problem and Chris thinks he has the perfect solution.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott tries to save pet guinea pig Oreo's broken leg; little rescue pup Pixie needs help after a dog bite accident left her with some shocking injuries and Scott makes an alarming discovery inside French bulldog Winston’s mouth!

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott helps a badly injured young fox rescued from a local garden; poor little Shih Tzu Jake is struggling to walk on his extremely bowed legs; and a nerve wracking day for Scott when he performs surgery on the oldest dog he’s ever anaesthetised!

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is called out to Edgars Mission on the outskirts of Melbourne to deal with an extremely rare case - Charity the lamb was born without hooves on her right side and without some form of intervention her life will be cut short. Chris suggests something untried on a sheep in Australia - prosthetics hooves.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is called out to visit 42 year old Galah Pretty, who has a fast growing lump on his leg that is deeply concerning to owner Maurizio. Even though surgery on the old bird could kill it Maurizio is not keen on Chris’ alternative.

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Noelle and Luke have been living in an apartment, but with three children it was time for a house with a backyard and …a dog to play in that backyard! Can Dr. Lisa Chimes find them the perfect dog?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Single mum Jenny and her three kids live in a rented house with a big backyard and son Harrison wants a dog. The backyard is in need of repair and the family can’t decide on what sort of dog to get. Can they all agree on the one dog?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Jo is a single mum with two little girls, she’d like a dog as part of their family. Jo loves running and would love a dog that can join her, but having two small girls a smaller dog might be better. Can Dr. Lisa find the right dog?

programme.title: Dr Lisa to the Rescue
programme.desc: Lisa and Stuart are hoping to find a playmate for their daughter, Roxy. Roxy has a list of things that she requires in her new ‘bestie’, but are they achievable? Dr. Lisa will search high and low to find Roxy her little friend.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott receives an SOS from the local vicar who desperately needs help with her fear aggressive dog; a lively young cat undergoes a double knee operation after an awkward fall; and what’s causing nurse Regan’s pet snake to go off his food?

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott must perform a risky operation to save an 8 day old puppy’s life; cat fur flies when 3 rescue cats come in for treatment; an eye surgery doesn’t go quite to plan for graduate vet Phoebe; and birthday celebrations for Scott’s beloved dog Betty.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: When miniature goat Monty enters the Bondi Clinic the vet nurses are all smitten until they discovery what the cute 4 week old is harbouring on his skin!

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Miniature Horse Charlie has a severe problem with his mouth that Chris needs to investigate, but getting access to the tiny creatures teeth becomes a near impossible task.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott is confronted with one of the most shocking cases of neglect he has ever seen, a challenging total hip replacement for a tiny 5 pound Chihuahua and a chaotic cat invasion.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Scott puts himself in the firing line to treat an aggressive Rottweiler, Marion’s much-loved companion may have an incurable disease and there’s a new baby joining the Miller family.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris receives a call from a Melbourne school principal. She has a 4 month old staffy called Juno whose health is deteriorating rapidly. Chris brings to the dog to Sydney to get a CT scan to find out what is happening with the young pup and what they discover is something so rare, only 20 cases have been recorded world wide. Juno’s blood vessels are all mixed up, and she requires a very high-risk surgery to have any chance of survival.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ziggy the cat has a big problem – he weighs almost a third more than he should. Chris needs to re-educate both the cat and the devoted owner to ensure the cats deteriorating health is not compromised further.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew investigates a worrying lump on a horse for a possible killer disease, but can he get close enough to find out. And Doctor Rachel is feeling the pressure when a passionate wildlife warrior brings in two distressed little Aussies.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Romi faces multiple emergencies when Lucy the groodle crashes before and during surgery, and Andrew treats a seriously ill goat that could be infested with a life-threatening parasite.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet ER Luna has been rushed in to Alex with shocking injuries, Gerardo desperately tries to save a new born puppy, and a sock has gone missing and Ollie is facing serious trouble.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: A chocolate binge has left whippet Dash in danger of a fatal heart attack. Labrador Carson didn’t just snack on yoghurt, he’s devoured the entire plastic container, and Ralph is in extreme pain after a nasty encounter with a fish hook.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A huge shock as Scott and rookie vet Riaz are called out to treat two naughty chipmunks, a much-loved 11-year-old family cat could have cancer and a cute puppy gets a life saving nose job.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: Can Scott help an exotic dog with a terrible past, will foster carer Wendy succumb to the inner beauty of Bella the bull terrier and adopt her and new vet Riaz tackles some wild kittens.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this very special program the Bondi Vet travels to England to fulfill a dream he has always had about working in the UK. He is invited to join a clinic in Cornwall where he is presented with all sorts of animals great and small. From a diary calf requiring urgent surgery, to a prize winning duck with a torn foot that needs to be repaired in time for her next showing. He also treats a large Siberian Eagle Owl that requires an operation to fix a bad eye and must give the all clear to release two Atlantic Grey Seals that were washed up in recent storms.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In an emotion charged episode, Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail 3 day old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mum, and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. But it's no guarantee a mare will accept the little foal.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew must make a life and death decision on a close friend’s pet cow. Rachel investigates why a friendly young Labrador has developed a worrying limp, but can she calm her terrified patient down enough to even treat him.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode a critically ill kangaroo infant has Andrew and the young joey’s rescuer worried for its life. Dr Romi has her hand full with eight lively puppies, but will they get a clean bill of health?

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: Alex and Gerardo team up to save a greedy groodle that swallowed a tube of glue, Brooke battles a large bone stuck deep inside a dog’s throat and a tiny kitten is rushed in after a play session with the family dog goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: The moving story of a little rescue Staffordshire Terrier called Rosa that was used for excessive breeding and then dumped on the streets, a gardener rescues a parakeet with a broken leg and Scott’s new puppy is in trouble after swallowing something she shouldn’t have.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: A fascinating Sphynx cat has become a sex-pest after being driven mad by her raging hormones. Scott goes to Sheffield to meet a remarkable teenage animal activist and winds up treating a badly behaved meerkat.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris meets a labradoodle with a chronic sneezing problem. 2 year old Lulu suffers massive sneezing fits up to 4 times a day, and her devoted owner Kim is desperate for help. Chris fears Lulu may have a tumour.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has been invited to Abu Dhabi after a special invitation to visit an extraordinary veterinary hospital. The hospital is for sick and injured falcons, and they are treated like royalty. Chris has to preform delicate surgery on a falcon wing.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill
programme.desc: In this Vet on the Hill Christmas special, Scott goes head to head with one of Santa’s helpers and finds out that wrangling reindeers is hard work, a young family have their Christmas wish come true and a special party for six puppies that Scott helped bring into the world.

programme.title: Vet on the Hill

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal

programme.desc: Gotti reflects on his past and ponders on his relationship with Stacy and the brutal choices that forged his life in streets.

But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

Blood chaos & mayhem, the kind of betrayal that reminds us that no one can be trusted.

Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Guilty Victim

As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Walker Battle returns as the contestants for this week’s special prepare to put their best foot forward against the other legged robots. A competitor makes the house robots sweat in the knockouts.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Karma comes for one of the competitors as the Semi-Finals commence in spectacular fashion. There are no specials this week as the knockout battles take priority in deciding who will win the crown.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: More heat winners are pitted against each other in knockout competition. The robots attempt to ram, flip and burn their way to the finals, all while trying to avoid the house robots.

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: From the producers of Robot Wars, Rescue Robots is a robot inspired, challenge based gameshow. Teams of children pilot their chosen robots and attempt to overcome pre-set obstacles, prevent imminent disasters and save Calamity City.

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: Transporter, Ranger and Talon face a potential nuclear disaster. Will the team prevent meltdown, or will this challenge prove too explosive for them?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: The water pressure’s rising and if the team don’t get there soon the whole of Calamity City will be underwater. Will the team sink or swim?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: A series of major fires have broken out on the outskirts of Calamity City. Will the team extinguish the inferno before it blows it destroys all in its path?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: A satellite with vital scientific data has crash landed in the desert. Will the team be able to retrieve it safely, or will the information be lost forever?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Newcomers, veterans and a recent President enter the fray in this first Heat of the series. Competitors are eliminated left, right and centre and only the strongest will survive to compete in the finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A veteran only heat features the current reigning Champions, Carbide. Will Carbide’s streak be brought to an end by the other robots, more experienced and eager than ever?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Even the judges aren’t safe as two robots collide, sending shrapnel through the bullet-resistant shields around the arena. Two very different styles of robot meet in the finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One newcomer stares down seven veterans, will their induction into the arena be successful, or will their inexperience find them in the pit? One robot will have a second chance to qualify in the Redemption Round.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The final heat features only veterans, here for an opportunity to make up for their mistakes in the previous tournaments. Only one competitor will make it into the Grand Finals, and the others must suffer defeat, again.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: After lengthy repairs and inspirational pep talks, the qualifiers prepare to fight for the title. A 10-way Robot Rumble will give the victor a spot in the Grand Finals, alongside the heat winners.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors need to hold their own in this week’s trial, King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in centre of the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Even more barrels are stacked up, only to be knocked down by a competitor in another Pinball Warrior. After a one-sided fight, a unanimous decision from the judges decides the victor of this week’s heat finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This week’s special event has legs. The Walker Battle special featured robots that do not use wheels or tracks as locomotion battling it out, do they stand a chance against the house robots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Half-way through the heats and Pinball Warrior returns to Robot Wars as another robot comes to test their aim and score against the house robots. The arena claims another robot as the knockout competitions march on.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last robot football of The Third Wars in this week’s special. A spot in the final isn’t the only thing the heat final can offer one of the competitors this week.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The sixth Pinball warrior run introduces another competitor to test their skills against the targets, and the house robots. In the knockouts, the house robots are being exploited as the competitors over-crowd the CPZ zones.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: We see more teams from around the UK bringing in their unique, sometimes amusing, sometimes terrifying robots to battle against each other. Sergeant Bash’s flamethrower is put to good use in the knockouts.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This is what it’s been building up to, The Grand Final is here. Which of the successful semi-finalists will be crowned champion of Robot Wars: The Third Wars?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Initially released on VHS and broadcast on TV a year later, the World Championship featured sixteen robots from eleven different countries. A straight knockout competition would decide which robot would be known as the World Champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The wars begin yet again, competitors can only qualify by destroying or outsmarting their opponents, and doing their best to stay out of the house robots way. Sumo and Pinball Warrior will test the robots grit and accuracy.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six competitors, including World Champion Razer battle it out for a shot at the Fourth Wars title. Irreparable damage could mean the permanent end of one of the veteran competitors in the semi-finals.

programme.desc: Poisonous gas is leaking from an abandoned mine. Can the Rescue Robots prevent the entire city being wiped out?

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: Lightning strikes have damaged the communication network of Calamity City, the team has to fix it to bring order back to the people.

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: An unexploded bomb of unknown origin threatens the safety of Calamity City, the Rescue Robots have to dispose of it sor risk destroying the whole city.

programme.title: Rescue Robots
programme.desc: Two research droids have gone missing whilst investigating bizarre volcanic activity. Will the Rescue Robots find them in time?

programme.title: MechMania

programme.title: Loading & Transporting On Site The Huge Liebherr 984 Excavator

programme.title: Liebherr 974 Excavator & Cat 352F With Hydr. Hammer Loading Stone Layers In Bell B50D
programme.desc: The Liebherr 974 hydraulic excavator, a true beast of the quarry world, is loading Bell B50D articulated dump trucks with material that has first been broken up by the Caterpillar 352F excavator, equipped with a Montabert hydraulic breaker. The breaker works relentlessly to fracture tough rock formations, allowing the 974 to load fast and efficiently.

programme.title: Cat 385C, Terex RH30F & Liebherr 954 Excavators Breaking & Loading Stones

Hired to protect the next shipment, Sartana fends off numerous incompetent villains, surviving their attempts on his life. Meanwhile, his nemesis, Sabbath—known for his white coat and parasol—arrives in town. With tensions rising, Sartana and Sabbath are headed for a final showdown to settle the score.

programme.title: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
programme.desc: Steve McGowan returns from war to avenge his father’s murder by a ruthless landowner. Imprisoned, he escapes with a bandit and steals a stagecoach—only to find the villain’s fiancée inside. As hired guns close in, alliances shift, and the fight for justice takes an unexpected turn.

Alongside bounty hunter Pancho Corrales, Sullivan faces treachery, culminating in a deadly showdown where only he survives to save a prisoner.

programme.title: Who Finds a Friend Finds a Treasure

They shipwreck on an island, defend a tribe from pirates and discover a Japanese fort with treasure. programme.title: Love hurts
programme.desc: Germana is an untalented and unlucky aspiring actress, a somewhat inconsiderate mother and the mistress of a rich lawyer who supports her financially. Elisabetta, her neighbour, on the other hand, is a successful doctor, too closed in her schemes to realise her husband is homosexual until she is left alone with many questions. When Gianmarco, a family man in a work crisis, saves Germana's daughter from an accident, sparks fly between them. Too bad she does not know that he is married and is Elisabetta's friend. Fate brings them face to face with reality when, during a holiday in Sicily, they all meet again, forcing them to confront each other.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada 500 años, el Castillo Prisión aparece y secuestra a inocentes viajeros. Abuelo Pitufo despega en su globo hacia el castillo, donde se encuentra con Nana Pitufa, que lleva desaparecida 500 años. Tienen poco tiempo para escapar; de lo contrario, ¡se convertirán en invitados permanentes!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachón, Pitufo Carpintero y Pitufo Filósofo pierden el telescopio de Papá Pitufo y Scour, el señor de los objetos perdidos, lo encuentra. Los Pitufos le dicen que darían cualquier cosa por recuperarlo, y Scour se apropia así de sus posesiones más preciadas: su fortaleza, su habilidad y su inteligencia. Entonces, viajan hasta sus dominios para recuperar lo que han perdido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Némesis aparece en la Biblioteca de los Magos para robar el conocimiento de los Archivos del Mal y hacerse con la Piedra de la Longevidad. Pero Pitufo Filósofo salva la situación sin darse cuenta, ya que cambia el libro de cocina de Pitufo Goloso por el libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina y Nana Pitufa comparten casa y se sacan de quicio la una a la otra, así que ha llegado el momento de que Nana Pitufa tenga su propia casa. Mientras Nana Pitufa y Pitufina salen en busca de una planta calienta hogares, los demás diseñan la casa más pitufantástica posible para ella.

programme.title: De Lo Que Están Hecho Los Sueños
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo plan que le permitirá aniquilar a los Pitufos: ahora va a introducirse en sus sueños. Por suerte, Papá Pitufo ha oído hablar de la mágica Corona de los Sueños…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El pobre Pitufo Perezoso ya no puede dormir. Cree que está viviendo sus últimos momentos, y se dispone a hacer todas las cosas emocionantes que siempre estuvo demasiado cansado para hacer…

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la curiosa caja que los Pitufos encontraron en la orilla del río? Si lo supieran, los Pitufos ni siquiera pensarían en abrirla. De esa forma, evitarían caer en las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Sonámbulos
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel está seguro de que ha encontrado la solución definitiva al fastidioso asunto de los Pitufos. Su flauta mágica convertirá sus tranquilos sueños en pesadillas…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío…

programme.title: La Absopitufiasombrosa Máquina
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa una máquina que hará que los Pitufos controlen el clima a su voluntad.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Y El Árbol Del Dinero
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabólico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es más agradable que él. Él quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caerá en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Varita Mágica
programme.desc: Con una receta que le prestó Ómnibus, Papá Pitufo crea una varita mágica que Pitufo Torpe se lleva y pierde en el bosque. Poco después, reciben la visita de Gigantón y, antes de que pueda comerse todas las pitufrutas, Papá Pitufo encuentra la varita mágica y lo aleja.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los Pitufos se preparan para el Festival de las Estrellas, Gargamel consigue infiltrar entre ellos una criatura que emite un olor a podrido tan intenso que le permitirá encontrar fácilmente la Aldea Pitufa. Papá Pitufo se da cuenta de que la criatura maloliente es de otro planeta, y manda a Plumífero que la devuelva a su hogar antes de que Gargamel les encuentre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Gruñón aprende que las emociones pueden ser fantásticas, sobre todo después de que la malvada Clorhidris cree un corazón de hielo para despojar a todos de la bondad y el amor.

programme.title: Conociendo El Futuro
programme.desc: Baltasar el encantador es un hombre con visión. Sabe que la era de la alquimia está llegando a su fin. El futuro pertenecerá a aquellos que comprendan la ciencia, pero… ¿cómo puede conocer el futuro? Quizá secuestrando a Padre Tiempo. Los Pitufos ayudarán a arreglar la situación después de que Pequeño Trueno, un dinosaurio, escape a través de una rotura en el tejido del tiempo.

programme.title: El Pitufo Sospechoso
programme.desc: ¿Puedes creer que Pitufo Filósofo condujo al malvado Gargamel hasta la Aldea Pitufa? Por supuesto, él no lo hizo. Sin embargo, los demás sospechan de él…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¡Pitufo Torpe ha desenterrado una extraña piedra! En ella, puede ver los eventos que van a suceder… ¡No obstante, conocer parte del futuro a veces trae mala suerte!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio ha decidido dedicarse al bienestar de los demás Pitufos. Va a curarles de todos sus males…con la ayuda del malvado Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aman las trufas y las trufas son de los Trolls. No será nada fácil que los pitufitos azules tengan un banquete.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se darán cuenta de que se convertirá en una especie de mamá pitufo para todos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo recuerda las emocionantes aventuras de Soñador en el mar, con tortugas, ballenas, islas desiertas…y piratas!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El robo del oro de las hadas por parte de Gargamel casi lleva a la guerra a los Pitufos con las hadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La producción teatral de los Pitufos "Pitufo Robin" se convierte en realidad con un actor real del legendario héroe.

programme.title: Ahora Los Pitufeas Y Ahora No
programme.desc: Los troles subterráneos capturan a los Pitufos para que sean sus esclavos. Papá Pitufo ingeniosamente los libera y luego destruye la bola de cristal mágica que les concede el poder sobre los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Para demostrar lo válido que es su «Gran libro de supervivencia en la naturaleza», Pitufo Filósofo se lleva a los Pitufitos al pantano. Allí, gracias a su experto consejo, el pequeño grupo se extravía, queda atrapado en arenas movedizas y es capturado por el Rey Verrugoso. Afortunadamente, el Rey Verrugoso está con ganas de jugar y decide hacer una caza del Pitufo. Desafortunadamente, Pitufo Filósofo cree que es un líder por naturaleza…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel y Baltasar se ponen a los mandos de un Robotín gigante para obligar al rey Gerard a que les entregue a Pitufo Robotín. Cuando el Robotín está a punto de destruir el castillo, Gigantón, el nuevo, enorme y extraño amigo de Pitufo Robotín, vence al Robotín. Pitufo Robotín sufre daños durante la batalla, pero Pitufo Carpintero lo arregla y le implanta una caja de voz que le permite decir «¡Hola!».

programme.title: Poema Al Tiempo
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero, Pitufo Filósofo, Pitufo Torpe y Pitufina descubren el reloj de arena del tiempo en una cueva y empiezan a trastear con él, lo que provoca que el tiempo se descontrole para todos los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un malvado brujo captura a los Pitufos para usarlos en su plan para robar todo el oro del Rey Argón.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espíritu deportivo, la alegría y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo le da a Pitufo Debilucho una crema especial para que la utilice y recupere su fuerza. Poco después, recibe una condecoración por sus heroicos actos de fortaleza, y su autoestima se dispara cuando se da cuenta de que la crema es simplemente mermelada de pitufrutas.

programme.title: El Pitufo Reportero
programme.desc: Pitufo Curioso ha tenido una idea: ¿por qué no imprimir un boletín con todas las noticias de la aldea? Está seguro de que sus cotilleos sobre los Pitufos interesarán a todos los lectores. Pero las cosas no salen exactamente según lo previsto cuando Papá Pitufo encuentra superpitufrutas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Ya No Tengo Miedo
programme.desc: Una vez más, el infalible plan de Gargamel para atrapar a los Pitufos ha fracasado. Los Pitufos aprovechan para gastarle una broma: disfrazados de pequeños ángeles azules, le enseñarán a enmendar su conducta…

programme.title: El Capricho De Travieso
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que, si atrapas un trol, este puede concederte un deseo? Resulta que Aloysius el trol ha quedado atrapado en una de las pitufitrampas de Gargamel. Pitufo Colérico le libera y, como recompensa, consigue que los demás Pitufos satisfagan todos sus caprichos. Esto acarrea un montón de problemas para los Pitufos, ya que los Pitufitos, en ocasiones, piden cosas que no son buenas para ellos… ni tampoco para los demás.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Miedoso entra corriendo en la aldea y grita que el cielo se está cayendo. Justo en ese mismo momento, Papá Pitufo está aquejado de un incontrolable ataque de estornudos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Práctico aprende que es mejor haber pitufado que no haber pitufado nunca cuando descubre que su amor verdadero es una sirena. ¿Podrán vivir juntos para siempre?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Poeta y Pintor se sienten poco valorados y huyen a una isla tormentosa sin saber que Gargamel los sigue hasta allí.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: El Amo Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador es el reticente amo de un genio llamado Gourdy, cuyo entusiasmo por ser servicial es quizá algo excesivo. Tras un nuevo incidente provocado por el exceso de celo de Gourdy, Pitufo Labrador le dice algo que no debería haber dicho y Gourdy desaparece. ¿Y a que no adivinas quién lo encuentra? En efecto: Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. ¿Y quién podría arrebatar a Gourdy de las manos de Escrupuloso, sino el propio Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos mágicos de cristal citoplásmico que le permitirán intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papá Pitufo. ¿Qué otro plan mejor que ese podría haber? Una vez que esté en el cuerpo de Papá Pitufo, llevará a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por juegos del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Perro, el perro de los Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Pitufo Carpintero se encuentra con una anciana trol en el bosque, que le suplica que le ayude a librarse de un grano rojo que tiene en la nariz… ¡dándole un buen puntapié! Pitufo Carpintero la ayuda sin mucho convencimiento. Y el resultado resulta sorprendente para él.

programme.title: Pitufan Nuestra Canción
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a la flauta mágica de Woody para que la música que salga de ella pase de ser buena a ser mala. Gargamel captura a los Pitufos, pero Sasita les salva diciéndole a Gargamel que le ama. Este toca la flauta, pero la música se desvanece a medida que Gargamel se ve inundado de sentimientos de amor, y termina por liberar a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tontín y Pitufina son capturados para ser exhibidos en una Feria. Papá Pitufo aprovecha la torpeza de Gargamel para rescatarlos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Natural y Travieso roban la fórmula de Gargamel para hacer otro Pitufo - otra pitufa para acompañar a Pitufina. Así pues, crean a Sassette, que crea problemas por doquier. Haciendo uso de su poción, Papá Pitufo convierte la malvada creación de Gargamel en una simpática Sassette.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Otra estupenda producción del teatro de los Pitufos basada en los personajes de Alejandro Dumas. Incluye algunas líneas de Romeo y Julieta. Una obra maestra de la escena.

programme.title: La Fórmula Aniquiladora
programme.desc: Existe una palabra mágica aterradora. Cuando pronuncias esa palabra hacia algo o alguien, ¡haces que se desvanezca en la nada! ¿Podrán los Pitufos anular su malvado poder antes de que Gargamel se apropie de ella?

programme.title: El Pitufo De Troya
programme.desc: Gargamel, el malvado mago, ha ideado un nuevo plan para capturar a los Pitufos: ha construido una estatua gigante con la forma de Papá Pitufo. Espera que, al verla, los Pitufos lleven la estatua a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está harto. Los Pitufitos y Sasita siguen inventándose historias sobre él con desagradables consecuencias. Por eso, prepara una fórmula mágica, extraída del libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo, que hace que los pequeños Pitufos crezcan y crezcan cada vez que dicen mentiras. Pero no había contado con que ahora Gargamel tiene una forma de capturar a los Pitufitos.

programme.title: La Brigada De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando en la Aldea Pitufa forman una brigada de incendios para combatir las llamas que devoran la cocina de Pitufo Goloso, se dan cuenta de que Gargamel les ha dejado sin agua. Sin embargo, no se da cuenta de la fragilidad de su presa, que se rompe y provoca que el agua arrastre a Gargamel y Azrael e inunde la Aldea Pitufa, extinguiendo el fuego.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos niños y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que están poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: A consecuencia de un loco experimento, Pitufo Torpe puede ahora almacenar interminables conocimientos en su memoria. Gargamel lo captura e intenta que le revele la fórmula de invisibilidad de Papá Pitufo, pero, en el último segundo, Pitufo Torpe le engaña diciéndole unos ingredientes erróneos.

programme.title: Cosas Que Putifan En La Noche
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Colérico pierde a su oso de peluche Huggy, no consigue dormir a pesar de los esfuerzos de Papá Pitufo por convencerle de que los osos de peluche son mágicos y pueden cuidar de sí mismos. Gargamel se tropieza con la Aldea Pitufa y Huggy regresa convertido en un oso gigante para espantar y salvar a Pitufo Colérico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Indeciso, tal como su nombre indica, no consigue decidirse sobre nada. Los otros Pitufos le llevan al bosque para hacer una prueba de supervivencia en la que únicamente pueda encontrar el camino de vuelta a casa tomando decisiones. Sin embargo, acaba en el castillo de Baltasar.

programme.title: Lenguaje De Señas
programme.desc: Los Pitufos conocen a un elfo del bosque, que les enseña la lengua de signos después de que Gargamel les administre una poción de enmudecimiento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un hechizo ha alterado las cajas sorpresa explosivas de Pitufo Bromista. Imagina la cara de desconcierto que se le queda a este guasón cuando se da cuenta de que todas las sorpresas que entrega a otros incautos Pitufos en realidad contienen regalos. ¡Se acabaron las explosiones, las bromas y la diversión! Y a eso se le une su poco envidiable posición como el Pitufo más popular de la aldea, rodeado de admiradores que no cesan de pedirle más obsequios…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogata consigue los pendientes dorados mágicos de Sonoria, que le permitirán oír las voces de los Pitufos desde lejos. Siguiendo los ronquidos de Pitufo Perezoso, está a punto de llegar hasta la Aldea Pitufa, pero entonces los sonidos del cuerno de Pitufo Armonía comienzan a resonar en sus pendientes y huye enfurecida de vuelta a casa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada mañana, los duendecillos del agua depositan rocío sobre las hojas del bosque. No imaginas todo lo que ocurrirá cuando Pitufo Miedoso se transforme con la varita mágica que crea las gotas de rocío…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Fortachón descubre a un caballero que lo ayuda a combatir a un Dragón, pero éste huye y deja a Fortachón defendiendo a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aman las trufas y las trufas son de los Trolls. No será nada fácil que los pitufitos azules tengan un banquete.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos Monstruosos
programme.desc: Es la noche de los fantasmas y todos los Pitufos se preparan para la elegante fiesta de disfraces… pero Pitufo Filósofo se hace con el libro de magia de Papá Pitufo y todos los Pitufos se transforman en criaturas horrendas, aunque divertidas. No obstante, el peligro acecha…

programme.title: Una Campana Para Azrael
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a una campana atada a la cola de Azrael que conducirá al gato hasta los Pitufos. Pero Papá Pitufo es más astuto que él y lanza un contra hechizo que lleva al mago hasta Gigantón, en lugar de hasta los deliciosos Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En el Día de la Infelicidad, los Pitufos tienen que ser infelices para poder apreciar su felicidad durante el resto del año. Gargamel inventa un detector de felicidad para encontrar a los Pitufos, pero lo usa justo el único día en el que los Pitufos no son felices. En su lugar, encuentra a una pareja de dragones felices y desata su ira.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos sabemos que Pitufo Gruñón odia varias cosas. Pero la cosa que odia más que nada es el agua, cuando hay suficiente para que se pueda ahogar. Pitufo Gruñón no sabe nadar. Y cuando los Pitufos notan esto y le tratan de enseñar cómo sobrevivir en el agua, el malvado mago Gargamel hace que todo sea un poco más peligroso de lo que debería ser...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se darán cuenta de que se convertirá en una especie de mamá pitufo para todos…
